work.title: Musik til Adam Oehlenschlägers skuespil "Aladdin"
Music for Adam Oehlenschläger's Play "Aladdin eller den forunderlige Lampe"
Aladdin

history.p: Gade was only twenty-two years old and still violin pupil in the Royal Danish Orchestra, when August Bournonville asked him in collaboration with the leader of the orchestra, P.F. Funck, to write and arrange the music, as Adam Oehlenschläger's dramatic poem "Aladdin eller den forunderlige Lampe" was adapted to a play. It was Gade's first work for the theatre.

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in grey cardboard cover with handwritten library label with the monogram of King Frederik IX on the front cover: DET KONGELIGE BIBLIOTEK / MUSIKAFDELINGEN / N.W. Gade / Aladdin / Supplement No. 1. Written in ink. Paper: 16 staves. Paginated pp. 1-21, one p. blank, then pp. 2-1 (bound in wrong order.) On fol.1r in upper left-hand corner dated: "11/3. 1839."
